decisions.reason: Removing the final paragraph from the referenced manuscript section does not change the separate constraint excluding an unintended newline marker from the book title.
The paragraph deletion is already owned by final manuscript content integrity and does not change the general copyediting goal, sentence-clarity rule, or meaning-preservation rule.
The source does not identify the removed paragraph as back matter or author-biography content and therefore does not change this requirement.
Removing manuscript text does not alter image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The paragraph deletion does not resume or modify the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
The source changes manuscript content but does not alter any requested publishing-process or prerequisite guidance.
The deletion of a text paragraph has no necessary effect on illustration permission, source, review, or suitability criteria.
Message 162 removes a paragraph but does not change the italic or quotation-mark typography rules for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The source does not concern Chapter 18 heading structure, punctuation, capitalization, or visual hierarchy.
Although deleting content could eventually affect pagination, the source does not necessarily change the existing requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after trim size is fixed.
Removing a paragraph from an interior manuscript section does not change the cover image count, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover choice.
